subject: Bluepeak AI — prepay structure (12–24m) options and term discounts
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@bluepeak.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Bluepeak Finance <procurement@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluepeak prepay options — 12/18/24m proposals and credits

Hi Elena / Samir,

Great speaking with you this morning — appreciate the context on your Q3 roadmap and the bursty eval traffic for the recommender experiments. Per our call, attached is a concise outline of two prepay approaches that balance unit economics with runway flexibility. High-level options: 

Option A — 12 month (annual prepay)
- Total commit: $180,000 prepay for year 1 (estimated run-rate to start)
- Term discount: 15% off hosted list rates
- Credits: $20,000 account credit applied up-front for infra testing / pilot bursts
- Ramped minimums: months 1–3 = 50% of monthly pro-rated commit, months 4–12 = 100%
- Unused credits: expire at year-end (can be converted to 30% carryover for an admin fee)

Option B — 24 month (multi-year)
- Total committed value: $320,000 over 24 months
- Term discount: 25% off hosted list rates (annualized)
- Credits: $50,000 account credit, 50% issued up-front, 50% after month 6 if usage milestones met
- Ramped minimums: months 1–6 = 60% of monthly pro-rata, months 7+ = 100%
- Breakage policy: up to 40% of unused credits can roll to year 2 if minimums hit

Questions for you so we can lock a clean term sheet:
1) Do you want credits available to apply to overage charges, or only to reserved commit usage?
2) Is Bluepeak comfortable with the proposed ramp profile or should we tighten the early-month floor?
3) Do you have a PO timeline so we can align DocuSign and onboarding?

Attached: BP-term-sheet-v1.pdf (short summary) and usage-forecast.xlsx (requested format).

If helpful, I can pull together an 18-month middle-ground (blended discount) — happy to sketch that if you prefer.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0147

---Attachment stub: BP-term-sheet-v1.pdf (1 page, summary); usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Moreno <elena@bluepeak.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluepeak prepay options — 12/18/24m proposals and credits

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the clear options and for the quick turn. A few clarification items from our end:

- Credits usage: we'd like credits to be able to apply both to reserved commit usage and to cover overage (helps cash flow). Is that possible?
- Carryover: our CFO is sensitive to full breakage — would Bluepeak be able to carry up to 50% of unused credits into the following year (for multi-year only)?
- Vesting: for the 24m option we prefer a smaller milestone cadence (e.g., 25% up-front, 25% at month 6, 25% at month 12, 25% at month 18) to reduce churn risk.
- PO timing: we're preparing a budget request this week; if we can get a term we can submit a PO by 7/17.

One practical constraint: we are YC-backed with limited runway, so a large upfront prepay (100% year 1) will be a stretch. If you can propose an 18-month plan that reduces upfront and provides predictable monthly invoicing, that would be ideal.

Can you send an 18-month sketch and highlight final pricing after discounts so I can take to finance?

Thanks,
Elena
Co-founder & Head of Product
Bluepeak AI
elena@bluepeak.ai

On Wed, Jul 8, 2026 at 09:12 Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Bluepeak prepay options — recommend counter for YC startup

Aditya / Laura,

Forwarding Elena's note — Bluepeak is asking for an 18-month plan with reduced upfront. My read: reasonable to offer an 18m that preserves unit economics but gives them runway. Proposal suggestion (for approval):

- 18 month blended commit: $260,000 total (annualized ~ $173k/year equivalent)
- Discount: 20% blended off hosted list rates
- Credits: $35,000 account credit (30% up-front, 70% vesting at 6 & 12 month milestones)
- Upfront cash: 40% of total at signing, remaining invoiced quarterly in arrears (helps runway)
- Carryover: allow 30% of unused credits to roll into the second year; full breakage otherwise
- SLA / reporting: monthly usage report + quarterly checkpoint for potential top-up

I think this hits finance halfway (less upfront than 12m) while avoiding the deeper discount required for a full 24m. Attached term-sheet with redlines. Can we sign off on 20%? I have delegated discount authority up to $20k; anything deeper needs final approval.

If approved I'll send a clean counter and include DocuSign links.

Thanks,
Mina

---Attachment stub: BP-term-sheet-v1.pdf (redlines)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bluepeak prepay options — recommend counter for YC startup

Mina —

Good framing. I'm comfortable with the 18m at 20% as long as we keep the following guardrails: 
- Max discount authorized: 20% (approved)
- Credit top-up limited to $35k total; we should aim to slip $35k (30% up-front) as you proposed
- Carryover: 30% roll into year two only if both Q2 and Q4 usage milestones are met
- Delegated credit top-up approval: you can commit up to $10k additional in promo credits; anything > $10k requires finance sign-off

Approve sending the counter with these clauses. Please include a HubSpot deal update and push DocuSign with two signing envelopes (PO and MSA).

Aditya
Head of Sales — Early Stage, Redwood Inference
